ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This online course section includes a 4 day workshop that will be held from July 16 to July 19 and the remainder of the course will be online. Enrollment in the section is restricted to participants in the Engaging Children's Minds workshop.
